rows.role_title: أمين عام هيئة البيعة — Secretary General of the Allegiance Commission
rows.text: SPA, date line Makkah 28 Ramadan 1427 / 20 October 2006: the Royal Court issued a statement reproducing Royal Order A/136 dated 26/9/1427 AH, which cites Article 24 of the Allegiance Commission Law issued by Royal Order A/135 of 26/9/1427 AH; item First: 'يعين معالي الأستاذ / خالد بن عبدالعزيز التويجري أمينا عاما لهيئة البيعة'; signed 'عبدالله بن عبدالعزيز'.
rows.locator: Date line; statement; order number and date; recitals; item First; signature; trailer 0636 (06:36 Makkah time)

rows.text: Royal Order A/136, reproduced in the same Royal Court statement, opens 'نحن عبدالله بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود ملك المملكة العربية السعودية'.

bounded_scope: King, Crown Prince and Allegiance Commission Secretary General observations for CLAUDE-C01-45 only (sa_king, sa_crown_prince and sa_succession_secretary). Attestations, an appointment, delegations and deputations of state affairs and their end, a signature on the King's behalf, scheduled and held pledges and procedure stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The CLAUDE-C01-06 holders and the CLAUDE-C01-25 chair roles are outside this extract.
